correctness.rationale: From the explicit forbidden THIRD edge joining any endpoints of distinct selected edges, selected components are exactly isolated H (one row/two columns), V (two rows/one column), or L (two edges as a bend on two rows/two columns); different components use disjoint rows and columns. For l bends, h horizontal, v vertical, size k=2l+h+v and occupied rows k+v<=p, columns k+h<=q. At optimum k=p one has v=0 and all rows occupied, forcing 2l+h=p; partition rows, assign disjoint column blocks and choose 4^l bend centers, yielding the claimed factorial summand. Odd square parity precludes p; the two exhaustive p−1 cases (h,v)=(0,0),(1,1) give the second formula. The h=p summand controls fixed-p asymptotic. An independently coded original-graph adjacency/third-edge checker exhaustively matched (p,q)=(2,2),(2,3),(2,4),(3,3),(3,4),(4,4), including 12,45,288 optimizer counts; finite tests corroborate general combinatorial bijection.
